summary: IMC Rare Earths Ltd, a Brazilian foreign private issuer listed on NYSE American, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 10, 2026, announcing laboratory-scale metallurgical testwork results from its Itarantim ionic adsorption clay rare earth project in Brazil. Terbium recoveries reached as high as 95.2% (averaging 81.1%) in composite COMP C2, with dysprosium averaging 46.1%; the company also produced a mixed rare earth carbonate. The filing is an operational/technical update, not a special situation; it involves no transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor mandate, or structural mechanics. Watch future resource and metallurgical updates.
